exitCodes.meaning: The command ran and failed: generation, QC, publication, assembly, a stopped batch, a download, an integrity check or an internal error.
The invocation was refused before any work: an unknown command or flag, a missing or invalid value, text over the limit, a reused request ID or an unsupported contract version.
A named voice, speaker, model, History item or input file does not exist (sysexits EX_NOINPUT).
A required model is not installed or speech recognition is unavailable (EX_UNAVAILABLE).
The output destination cannot be created or written (EX_CANTCREAT).
Storage is full or a read or write failed (EX_IOERR).
A temporary condition: the engine or a store is busy, memory is short, the same request is in progress or the network is unavailable; a later retry may succeed (EX_TEMPFAIL).
Voice-cloning consent was not confirmed or a path lies outside the allowed roots (EX_NOPERM).
Configuration or a data store is invalid, or History has a newer schema than this CLI reads (EX_CONFIG).
Cancelled by SIGINT (Ctrl-C) after the command's owned cleanup.
Cancelled by SIGTERM after the command's owned cleanup.
